description: A woman in a headscarf and brown dress sits at a long wooden bench, holding a mallet raised and bent over a tangle of fibre. Behind her a bearded man in a dark doublet stands holding a staff. Other figures sit on benches working on fibres along the walls of a vaulted stone hall with a gothic arched window letting in a shaft of light, a carved stone fireplace and doorway on the right. The style is a dark oil painting. No visible text, no frame.
